issue: करेंगी शोषण-पार्वती माँ — शोषण ('drying up, exploiting') gives a poor sense beside Kālī, Lakṣmī and Sarasvatī; पोषण ('nourishing') may be meant. The book and Drik Panchang both print शोषण, and no independent copy was found.
our reading: शोषण, as printed: Kālī, Lakṣmī, Sarasvatī and Pārvatī will dry up (destroy) [the evil].

issue: दिया फलित वर माँ मुस्काई — who gave the fruitful boon: Śrī Rāma (whose promise ends in cau8), or the Mother to someone not named.
our reading: A boon that would bear fruit was given (passive, as the line names no giver); the Mother smiled and came to the mountain to perform austerities.
alternatives: Rāma gave her the boon; the Mother, smiling, gave a fruitful boon (to the gods or her devotees).

issue: रक्षा हित निज शस्त्र चलाया — no subject; the Mother (who beheads Bhairava in the story) or the hero Lāṅgura, who has just received her command (cau26).
our reading: For protection, the Mother struck with her weapon.
alternatives: Lāṅgura, at her command, struck with his weapon.

issue: जम्बू द्वीप महाराज — literally the great king of Jambūdvīpa (India); the Mahārāja of Jammu (जम्बू) may be meant.
प्रगट हो अवतार — a prayer to the Mother to appear as an incarnation, or a wish that the incarnation (Kalki, promised in cau6) appear.
our reading: May the incarnation appear (अवतार प्रकट हो).
